R1.title: Verify before blocking on weak signal
R1.description: If the case rests on a single signal (including risk score alone) and assessed fraud probability < 0.70, recommend VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER or STEP_UP_AUTH before any block.

R2.title: Customer denies transaction
R2.description: Recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE. Add FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

R3.title: Customer confirms transaction
R3.description: Recommend CLOSE_NO_FRAUD. Note confirmation in case file.

R4.title: No reply within 24 hours
R4.description: Recommend MONITOR_CARD and DECLINE_TRANSACTION for pending authorizations. Escalate if exposure exceeds $500.

R5.title: Card testing sequence
R5.description: Three or more small online authorizations on one card within an hour, followed by a larger purchase: recommend DECLINE_TRANSACTION and STEP_UP_AUTH. If purchase over $100 has already cleared, recommend BLOCK_CARD.

R6.title: Shared origin
R6.description: When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, same billing region, or same recipient email in one window, recommend CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS for every card sharing it.

R7.title: Disputed but legitimate
R7.description: When customer disputes a charge that matches their recurring pattern (same merchant, same amount, monthly), recommend CREATE_CASE, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, and WARN_CUSTOMER. Do not block.

R8.title: Escalate when uncertain and exposed
R8.description: If verdict is uncertain and exposure exceeds $500, or evidence conflicts, recommend ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.

R9.title: Undocumented patterns
R9.description: When activity fits none of the known patterns but evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, and describe in own words.

R10.title: Strict multi-card block constraint
R10.description: Never BLOCK_ALL_CARDS unless at least two of the customer's cards show confirmed fraud or customer credentials confirmed compromised.
